preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 1000.
Each test case string s must have a length between 2 and 100.
Each test case string s must contain exactly one '(' and one ')'.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'YES' or 'NO' for each test case.

postconditions.expression: any(s.replace('?', '(') == '(' + '1' * (len(s) - 2) + ')' or s.replace('?', ')') == '(' + '1' * (len(s) - 2) + ')' for s in test_cases)
postconditions.description: The output must be 'YES' if it is possible to replace '?' with '(' or ')' to form a regular bracket sequence.
